entries.columnsContract: `on_deck_package_id FK, ordinal, product_fact_id FK, fact_kind, fact_revision, schema_ref, fact_digest, evidence_digest, reference_digest`
entries.constraintsContract: `PK(on_deck_package_id,ordinal)`及`UNIQUE(on_deck_package_id,product_fact_id,fact_revision)`；按factKind/id/revision排序；必须逐项引用同Run immutable Product Fact；历史Package读取以该relation连接`libra_product_fact_revisions`并展开同一typed `fact_json`，完整Product Fact Manifest不依赖current row或另一Domain Store

entries.columnsContract: `on_deck_package_id FK, ordinal, artifact_handle_id, artifact_kind, artifact_revision, artifact_digest, requirement_digest, materialization_state(workspace_only|included_product), reference_digest`
entries.constraintsContract: `PK(on_deck_package_id,ordinal)`及`UNIQUE(on_deck_package_id,artifact_handle_id,artifact_revision)`；按kind/handle/revision排序；只保存typed immutable Artifact Handle ref，不保存大bytes；完整Artifact Manifest由relation重建

entries.columnsContract: `on_deck_package_id FK, ordinal, material_key, context_role(original_input|structural_dependency|related_input), source_related_reference_id NULL, final_product_material_key NULL, final_product_material_keys_schema_ref NULL, final_product_material_keys_json NULL, disposition_kind(carried_forward|replaced_and_settled), mount_scope_id, inode, size_bytes, fingerprint_algorithm, fingerprint_version, content_fingerprint, endpoint_id, location, binding_revision, binding_evidence_digest, admitted_control_revision NULL, admitted_control_projection_digest NULL, derived_authority_digest NULL, settlement_expectation(retain|replace_or_move|remove_after_place), context_member_digest`
entries.constraintsContract: `PK(on_deck_package_id,ordinal)`及`UNIQUE(on_deck_package_id,material_key,context_role)`；Primary/structural variant要求Control pair并禁止Related fields；related variant要求source reference/derived authority且Control pair为NULL。每个Run Basis Related必须恰有一row并映射到同Package Product member：carried要求source/final materialKey相同且`replace_or_move`，replaced要求不同且`remove_after_place`；按materialKey/contextRole排序并进入offload及Related disposition set digest，单目标列与多目标JSON列必须恰好一者非NULL；JSON固定schemaRef为`helix://contracts/application-types/LibraOffloadProductMaterialKeys/v1`（仅该array），为2..1024个UTF-8排序唯一materialKey、≤128 KiB，只允许original_input/replaced_and_settled/remove_after_place，原source仍恰好一row；完整目标集合进入member/set/manifest摘要，不构成Arca动作选择或删除授权

entries.columnsContract: `receipt_id PK, offer_id, on_deck_package_id FK, package_digest, arca_acceptance_decision_id, arca_acceptance_decision_digest, result(accepted|rejected), handoff_receipt_id, handoff_receipt_digest, custody_id NULL, arca_binding_set_digest NULL, control_revision_set_digest NULL, rejection_digest NULL, closure_digest NULL, received_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `receipt_id=SHA-256(JCS({schema:"libra.product-delivery-receipt-id@1",offerId}))`，offer逐字节等于Package row且`UNIQUE(offer_id)`；accepted要求Custody/Binding/Control列非NULL、rejection/closure列NULL，并逐项无损保存`ArcaProductAcceptedMessage@1` Receipt；rejected要求Custody/Binding/Control列NULL且decision/receipt/rejection/closure digest逐项等于`ArcaProductRejectedMessage@1`与`LibraProductRejectionClosureResult@1`；terminal后immutable，相反终态稳定拒绝；`INDEX(result,received_at_ms)`

entries.columnsContract: `scope_id PK, shelf_id FK, provider(tmdb), provider_key, endpoint_id, mount_scope_id, shelf_root, root_location, placement_revision, current_version, active_build_id NULL, retirement_scope_id NULL, state_revision, state_digest, created_at_ms, updated_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `rowMutability=cas_lifecycle`；`UNIQUE(shelf_id,provider,provider_key)`；`UNIQUE(endpoint_id,root_location)`；目标与身份冻结，current_version与active_build_id按state_revision/state_digest CAS；未有Commit引用不等于Own；引用存在时不删除scope

entries.columnsContract: `build_id PK, scope_id, revision, expected_version, basis_schema_ref, basis_json, basis_digest, scope_schema_ref, scope_json, scope_digest, created_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `UNIQUE(scope_id,revision)`；Basis和Scope JSON上限`64 KiB`，精确SeriesPresentationBasis及SeriesPresentationScope；immutable；新build不得重写失败build的Basis/Source Result

entries.columnsContract: `relocation_id PK, scope_id, shelf_id, plan_schema_ref, plan_json, plan_digest, state(active|committed), state_revision, inventory_set_digest NULL, commit_marker NULL, created_at_ms, committed_at_ms NULL`
entries.constraintsContract: `UNIQUE(scope_id) WHERE state='active'`；`INDEX(shelf_id,state)`；Plan JSON上限`4 MiB`，完整冻结所有季head、正式材料及共享版本；Plan不可改写；active涵盖失败/恢复待处理，不能因Work失败释放迁移占用；committed仅由真实物理验证及全组Inventory提交建立

entries.columnsContract: `scope_id, revision, build_id, manifest_schema_ref, manifest_json, manifest_digest, verification_digest, committed_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `PK(scope_id,revision)`；`UNIQUE(build_id)`；Manifest JSON上限`16 KiB`，精确SeriesPresentationManifest，恰三项当前物理Identity/角色/位置/完整字节摘要；immutable；版本与head CAS及Control同Owner事务

entries.columnsContract: `scope_id, on_deck_run_id, custody_id, state(pending|committed|released), committed_version NULL, target_binding_digest, created_at_ms, updated_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `PK(scope_id,on_deck_run_id)`；`rowMutability=cas_lifecycle`；与Handoff B Accepted同事务pending，与On-deck Commit同事务committed；pending不是Own；不能因首个Season失败而丢掉其他pending责任

entries.columnsContract: `scope_id, shelf_entry_id, first_committed_version, state(active|released), reference_revision, reference_digest, created_at_ms, released_at_ms NULL`
entries.constraintsContract: `PK(scope_id,shelf_entry_id)`；`rowMutability=cas_lifecycle`；同一Season追加Episode不新增引用；Off-deck/注销与本Entry终态同事务释放；有active或pending引用不删除公共文件，最后引用释放不替代用户删除授权

entries.columnsContract: `commit_link_id PK, on_deck_run_id, scope_id, shared_version, manifest_digest, verification_digest, committed_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: `UNIQUE(on_deck_run_id)`；immutable；与On-deck Commit同事务固定当时共享版本及验证；当前健康另取共享head，禁止改写历史链接

entries.columnsContract: `shelf_id PK, name, target_endpoint_id, target_root_location, target_mount_scope_id, target_mount_scope_revision, status, current_standard_revision, current_placement_revision, routing_projection_revision, routing_projection_digest, created_at_ms, updated_at_ms`
entries.constraintsContract: mount scope pair是Platform opaque technical ref；active Shelf name不作为identity；Shelf创建时routing projection revision=1，任何后续`status/current_standard_revision`变化都对该revision执行CAS并加1，再按`ShelfRoutingTargetProjection@1`公式重算digest；`INDEX(status,shelf_id)`；不得保存Libra Routing Priority

entries.columnsContract: `rule_template_id PK, name, owner_kind(system|user), status(active|archived), current_revision, created_at_ms, archived_at_ms`
